structured_output.what_is_happening: "💲SATAN" is a PumpSwap pair about 44 minutes old. It was not launched through pump.fun: there is no launchpad and the contract address has no "pump" suffix. The pool was created 6 seconds after the token was minted. At detection, liquidity was about $66k and market cap about $54k. It had done about $291k of volume in its first hour and the price was up 147%. Three minutes later, reported liquidity is $0.01 and RugCheck's total market liquidity is $0.0078. The market-cap figure has jumped to $214k and the 1-hour price change to +871%. A market cap that high with a pool that is essentially empty is what the numbers look like after liquidity has been pulled or the pool drained. The creator still holds 61.05% of supply. The LP burn ratio is 0. The pair had about 1,124 unique buyers but only 116 unique sellers. In the past hour, at least two more "💲SATAN" tokens with the same emoji ticker were launched minutes apart, and both also show about $0 liquidity. That looks like one operator repeatedly launching copies of the same token.

authenticity.evidence: The creator holds 61% of supply and the LP was not burned. Reported liquidity collapsed from $66k to $0.01 within minutes. The same emoji ticker was launched repeatedly within minutes. There were 16 bundler wallets. Only 116 unique sellers against 1,124 buyers suggests many holders are trapped, or that the volume came from few real participants. GMGN rates this token's rat-trader and entrapment share at 61%, the same figure as the creator's holding. There are no socials at all.
